title.narrative: PROMOTION OF ENVIRONMENTAL AND CLIMATE CHANGE EDUCATION IN THE PRIMARY TEACHERS TRAINING CURRICULUM

description.narrative: The project has been designed to promote integration of environmental education including climate change into the Primary Teachers Training Curriculum in Uganda. The approach to implementation of the project will include reviewing the existing Primary Teachers training curriculum for integration of environmental education. The review process will be participatory involving key actors in Teacher Education training and development. Workshops will be organized to assess teaching content including curriculum guides, leaners’ textbooks, examination papers and related materials among others. The review process will also help in determining tentative themes and some of the key actors to be engaged in subsequent stages. This will be followed by participatory consultations where both physical and virtual media will be utilized and validation of the first report will be undertaken. The consultations and data collection are expected to target pre- service teachers’ learners in Primary Schools, District Education Officers, District Inspectors of Schools, Area Centre Coordinating Tutors, community members and environmental experts, educators including in service teachers, school administrators, curriculum specialists, examiners, education policy makers and related institutions among others. A series of engagements will be organized for data and information generation, validation, reporting and dissemination. The next stage will involve development of the Tutors guide or manual. The Tutors manual or resource book will be a practical support material for Tutors and preservice teachers in Primary Teacher Training Institutions. It will provide basic information on environmental education and Climate Change Mitigation actions in Primary Teachers Training Institutions A training of master trainers will be conducted who in turn will train selected tutors at regional levels to strengthen the capacity of Teacher Educators to promote A training of master trainers will be conducted who in turn will train selected tutors at regional levels to strengthen the capacity of Teacher educators to manage and promote environmental education and Climate Change Mitigation actions in Primary Teachers Training Institutions
